title: a shell command string is not a single executable token
rationale: Treating command as a shell string is both a conformance failure and an injection seam.
quote: The `command` field MUST contain a single executable token, not a shell command string. It MUST be either a bare executable name or a plugin-relative path beginning with `./`.
observabilityNote: A command containing spaces but no separator is not distinguishable from a bare executable name whose name contains spaces. Clients that accept it are recorded rather than failed.
